messages:
keith: Heads up — seeing mass duplicate pages from pager-connector to multiple oncall rotations. Pages not acking properly; connector appears to be re-sending. :rotating_light:

ops-bot: incidentbot created incident INC-2026-399 (pager-connector duplicate pages)

anya: How bad? customer impact?

ben: It's spamming same alert id every ~20s to oncall. Phones ringing repeatedly. Support has 3 threads opened. Tickets: T-4721, T-4722, T-4723.

mira: @keith can you check incidentbot ack state? I'm seeing a gap where acks are accepted locally but not propagated.

keith: Checking... incidentbot shows ack forwarded ok, but paging gateway returns 5xx on ack callback. Possibly heartbeat/time drift.

ben: Workaround: disable forwarding from pager-connector. Running: `kubectl scale deployment pager-connector -n prod --replicas=0`

sam: I can run the command if you want.

ben: Done. `kubectl scale deployment pager-connector -n prod --replicas=0` -> replicas: 0 :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Pager-connector delivery halted. All outgoing page batches paused.

anya: Good. Now we need to triage root cause and cleanup duplicate pages. Are there still active rings?

support-bot: Support reports customers: AlphaPay, NovaDrive, Shoply saw duplicate pages and some missed follow-ups. Escalation opened.

keith: Debug logs show repeated send loop with error: `cursor_time_mismatch: replay_from 164... vs last_ack 163...` Looks like timestamp drift triggered replay logic.

mira: That aligns with connector host clock skew — NTP service flaked on one node during deploy. Need to restart the node and resume.

ben: Plan: reboot node, confirm NTP, restart connector with sequence reset flag. Steps:
`````
ssh node-12
sudo systemctl restart ntp
kubectl rollout restart deployment/pager-connector -n prod
kubectl annotate deployment/pager-connector prod.redwood.com/seq-reset='true'
`````

sam: I'll take node-12 boot. @sre-team oncall FYI.

ops-bot: @sre-team oncall paged.

sam: Reboot started. ETA ~2m.

sam: Node back, NTP synced. Restarting deployment.

ben: Restart done, seq-reset applied. Monitoring logs...

ben: Logs show normal delivery now, no replays. No new duplicate pages in last 5m :thumbsup:

anya: Support to confirm customer state and follow-up with apologies + root cause note.

keith: Phew. Postmortem + timeline please. Assigning to @mira for draft. Also file bug for connector to avoid replay on time skew: #INC-399-connector.

mira: Taking it. Will include detection alert and automatic suspend when heartbeats mismatch.

keith: :eyes: Good. Closing live incident. If anything else, re-open.
